learned.description: Quick pre-flight bind test to verify port availability before launching services.
learned.example: python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(('', PORT)); print('bind ok'); s.close()"

learned.description: Detects and clears port collisions before respawning dependent services.
learned.example: ss -tlnp | grep 8889 && lsof -ti:8889 | xargs -r kill -9; sleep 1; tmux respawn-window -t hive-dev

orchestrator_sessions.goal: Reduce system load and memory pressure to resume paused research loops and stabilize hive operations.
orchestrator_sessions.summary: The hive is experiencing critical load and memory saturation (cores up to 2.88×, memory up to 47.2 GB) causing research_loop pauses across multiple sessions. Health is nominal on the default queue but resource contention is blocking progress. Immediate triage and resource rebalancing are required to restore throughput.

next_steps: Kill or gracefully suspend non-essential sessions (e.g., ps5-hive, opencode) to free memory and CPU.
Apply stricter cgroup limits and lower niceness for research_loop jobs to reduce core contention.
